## Discovery & Translational Science

**[Single-nucleus atlas identifies cell-state drivers of early-onset colorectal cancer](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04721-y)** — *Nature Medicine*
- A single-nucleus RNA sequencing atlas of 189 colorectal tumors across ages 20–90+ uncovers age-associated microenvironmental alterations and transcriptomic profiles specific to early-onset disease.
- Findings from Dana-Farber researchers provide structural insights into why colorectal carcinomas in younger patients display heightened clinical aggressiveness.

**[Engineered compact Cas12m variant achieves in vivo multiplexed gene activation](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42951949/)** — *PubMed*
- Researchers developed a miniaturized Cas12m CRISPR architecture optimized for multiplexed transcriptional activation in vivo.
- The engineered construct addresses size constraints inherent to viral vector delivery systems while maintaining target specificity.

**[FBXO22 identified as a viable E3 ligase for targeted protein degradation](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42950695/)** — *PubMed*
- Preclinical characterization demonstrates that the E3 ubiquitin ligase FBXO22 can be co-opted for PROTAC-mediated protein degradation.
- Expanding beyond CRBN and VHL ligases provides additional chemical starting points to overcome baseline resistance or tissue-restricted target expression.

**[Splicing-derived neutrophil neoantigens drive autoantibody responses in lupus](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42951964/)** — *PubMed*
- Investigation into systemic lupus erythematosus reveals that aberrant alternative splicing in neutrophils generates distinct neoantigens.
- Both autoreactive T and B cells selectively recognize these novel spliced peptides, linking dysregulated splicing directly to humoral autoimmunity.

**[MET signaling drives CD8⁺ T cell exclusion in head and neck cancer disparities](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.10.26.26366494)** — *medRxiv*
- Deep-learning spatial transcriptomics across head and neck squamous cell carcinoma cohorts reveals elevated MET expression associated with CD8⁺ T cell exclusion in Black/African American patients.
- Spatial profiling from a Phase 2 pembrolizumab trial suggests MET upregulation establishes an immune-excluded phenotype that limits checkpoint inhibitor efficacy.

**[PPMI analysis validates CSF α-synuclein seed amplification in prodromal Parkinson's disease](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.10.26.26366535)** — *medRxiv*
- Data from the Parkinson's Precision Medicine Initiative demonstrates CSF α-synuclein seed amplification assays achieved 94% positivity in participants presenting with REM sleep behavior disorder and hyposmia.
- Positivity rates dropped to 40% in participants with REM sleep behavior disorder without hyposmia, establishing stratifying criteria for pre-motor clinical trial enrichment.

**[Review summarizes mechanisms and clinical approaches in gram-negative resistance](https://www.nejm.org/doi/full/10.1056/NEJMra2506114)** — *NEJM*
- A comprehensive review details emerging resistance mechanisms and clinical management strategies targeting multi-drug resistant gram-negative bacterial pathogens.

## Early Trials — Phase I–II

**[Five-year PHERGain data supports chemotherapy-free regimen in HER2-positive early breast cancer](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04723-w)** — *Nature Medicine*
- Secondary 5-year analysis of the Phase 2 PHERGain trial validates a PET-guided adaptive strategy allowing omission of chemotherapy in select HER2-positive early breast cancer patients.
- Exploratory circulating tumor DNA dynamics correlated with long-term invasive disease-free survival, offering a non-invasive biomarker to guide treatment de-escalation.

**[Perioperative esketamine infusion reduces chronic pain post-thoracotomy](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42951789/)** — *PubMed*
- A multicenter, randomized, double-blind trial demonstrated that perioperative intravenous esketamine infusion significantly reduced the incidence and severity of chronic post-surgical pain following video-assisted thoracoscopic lung resection.

**[Shugan Xiaozhi formula demonstrates efficacy in MASLD Phase 2 trial](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42951121/)** — *PubMed*
- An exploratory 24-week randomized controlled trial in metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis patients with elevated alanine aminotransferase demonstrated significant reductions in hepatic steatosis and liver stiffness.

**[Biotech]** **[Iovance Biotherapeutics reports updated Phase 2 IOV-LUN-202 trial data](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2115760946316554467)** — *X / BioStocks*
- Treatment with the tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte (TIL) therapy yielded a 24.6% objective response rate (ORR) across 69 patients with non-squamous metastatic non-small cell lung cancer (mNSCLC).
- The company is incorporating a precision TIL strategy for second-line mNSCLC development.

## Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

**[Big Pharma]** **[Lilly's retatrutide beats Ozempic in Phase 3 head-to-head diabetes trial](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/retatrutide-ozempic-diabetes-trial-results-lilly-novo/873016/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
- Eli Lilly reported top-line 80-week Phase 3 results showing weekly retatrutide (a GIP/GLP-1/glucagon receptor triple agonist) at 12 mg achieved an average 2.2 percentage point HbA1c reduction compared to 1.8 percentage points for Novo Nordisk's Ozempic (semaglutide) in type 2 diabetes.
- Retatrutide also achieved superior body weight reduction over semaglutide, reinforcing its potential differentiation in metabolic disease.

**[Big Pharma]** **[TALAPRO-2 analysis establishes ctDNA biomarker dynamics in mCRPC](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42950862/)** — *PubMed*
- Biomarker analysis from the Phase 3 TALAPRO-2 trial evaluating talazoparib (Pfizer/Astellas) plus enzalutamide in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer showed baseline circulating tumor DNA profiles and circulating tumor cell kinetics strongly stratify progression risk and therapeutic response.

## Regulatory & Approvals

**[FDA proposes draft guidance for individualized gene therapy approvals](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/fda-personalized-gene-therapy-rare-disease-guidance/873004/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
- The FDA issued draft guidance outlining an "individualized feature space" framework allowing manufacturers of targeted gene therapies to clear additional disease-causing mutations in the same gene using preclinical laboratory data rather than conducting separate clinical trials for each ultra-rare variant.

**[FDA issues draft guidance on essential drug delivery performance for combination products](http://www.fda.gov/regulatory-information/search-fda-guidance-documents/essential-drug-delivery-performance-characteristics-devices-intended-deliver-drugs-and-biological)** — *FDA Guidance*
- Draft guidance outlines recommended performance data and testing specifications for device constituent parts intended to deliver drugs or biologics across IND, NDA, BLA, and MAA filings.

**[Biotech]** **[Vertex kidney disease candidate faces regulatory scrutiny over infection risk ahead of PDUFA](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/29/biotech-news-vertex-kidney-disease-drug-scrutinized-for-infection-risk/)** — *STAT+*
- Ahead of a November 30 FDA decision date, Vertex Pharmaceuticals' investigational kidney disease drug is under regulatory review regarding adverse infection signals observed during clinical testing.

**[FDA warns of counterfeit eye drops and unapproved supplements containing undisclosed pharmaceuticals](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/medication-health-fraud-notifications/ort-flx-may-be-harmful-due-hidden-ingredients)** — *FDA*
- Laboratory testing confirmed that over-the-counter joint and pain products Ort-Flx and RX7 Articulaciones contain hidden prescription ingredients, including diclofenac and dexamethasone (and methocarbamol in Ort-Flx), posing risks of serious cardiovascular, gastrointestinal, and immune adverse events.
- The agency also warned consumers against using counterfeit over-the-counter eye drops found in retail locations across several states (including FL, GA, LA, MS, and NC) after testing positive for bacterial contamination.

**[FDA details eCTD v4.0 implementation and forward compatibility guidance](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/electronic-regulatory-submission-and-review/electronic-common-technical-document-ectd)** — *FDA*
- CDER and CBER are accepting regulatory filings in eCTD v4.0 format as of September 16, 2024, and offer sample validation feedback for sponsors preparing official submissions within 12 months.
- Forward Compatibility for existing eCTD v3.2.2 applications across NDAs, BLAs, ANDAs, INDs, and Master Files is scheduled to take effect October 16, 2026.

## Business & Strategy

**[Biotech]** **[Flagship Pioneering combines three portfolio biotechs into Etcelera Therapeutics](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/flagship-etcelera-etiome-empress-cellarity-launch/872947/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
- Flagship Pioneering merged Etiome, Cellarity, and Empress Therapeutics to launch Etcelera Therapeutics, an AI-driven drug discovery company led by former Adaptimmune CEO Adrian Rawcliffe focused on novel target discovery and small-molecule development.

**[Big Pharma]** **[Novartis takes $1.9B impairment charge on failed asset; Lilly restructures global operations](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/lilly-global-markets-novartis-avidity-astellas-talzenna-prana/872857/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
- Novartis recorded a $1.9 billion impairment charge following the late-stage failure of an experimental therapy acquired in its $12 billion acquisition of Avidity Biosciences.
- Eli Lilly announced that head of Lilly International Patrik Jonsson will retire at the end of 2026, triggering the merger of its U.S. and international divisions into a unified unit called Lilly Global Markets, led by Ilya Yuffa.

**[Treasury rules on foreign investments ignite biopharma debate over cross-border licensing](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/29/biotech-licensing-deals-treasury-rules-stir-debate/)** — *STAT+*
- Biopharma executives and industry groups are divided over the scope of new U.S. Treasury Department rules restricting outbound foreign investments, specifically regarding exemptions for cross-border drug licensing transactions involving Chinese entities.

**[Big Pharma]** **[Eli Lilly beats Q3 expectations driven by Mounjaro and Zepbound growth](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2115758844932501671)** — *X / BioStocks*
- Quarterly revenue reached $24.4B (vs. $22.5B estimated) with EPS of $7.48 (vs. $6.50 estimated).
- Mounjaro generated $10.7B in worldwide revenue (up 65% year-over-year, including $5B in the U.S. and $5.7B internationally), while Zepbound brought in $5.3B.
- Full-year FY26 sales guidance was raised to $91B–$92B, up from the prior range of $85B–$87B.

**[Big Pharma]** **[Merck tops Q3 estimates on strong Keytruda franchise performance](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2115754222469677301)** — *X / BioStocks*
- Q3 revenue reached $18.1B (vs. $17.3B estimated), delivering an EPS of $2.49 (vs. $2.08 estimated).
- Combined quarterly sales for Keytruda and Keytruda Qlex totaled $8.6B.

**[Biotech]** **[Fractyl Health surveys consumer demand for procedural post-GLP-1 weight maintenance](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2115762353702846807)** — *X / BioStocks*
- Market research published by the company highlights substantial patient interest in a one-time procedural intervention to maintain weight loss following GLP-1 receptor agonist therapy.

## Public Health & Policy

**[HHS permits temporary enforcement discretion for peptide compounding](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/28/hhs-enforcement-discretion-policy-allows-peptide-compounding/)** — *STAT+*
- The U.S. Department of Health and Human Services issued a policy allowing compounding pharmacies temporary discretion to manufacture certain unapproved peptide formulations.

**[Lawmaker requests GAO investigation into TrumpRx drug savings](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/10/28/lawmaker-wants-gao-probe-trumprx-drug-pricing/)** — *STAT+*
- A member of the U.S. House of Representatives requested a Government Accountability Office audit to determine whether the federal TrumpRx platform has delivered measurable savings on retail prescription drugs.

**[Missouri Attorney General warns Eli Lilly over 340B claims data demands](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/10/28/battles-over-340b-lilly-reports-weight-loss-drug-results/)** — *STAT+*
- The Missouri AG directed Eli Lilly to cease requiring participating hospitals to submit 340B claims data as a prerequisite for purchasing discounted pharmaceuticals.

**Worth watching:** The FDA's draft guidance on individualized feature spaces for gene therapies could transform regulatory pathways for ultra-rare diseases, allowing post-approval mutation expansion based entirely on pre-specified in vitro data.

- Biology & Health
    - [Put these in your Ears and Protect your Brain!](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BM1N3Mz70a4) -- Physionic
        - The video addresses the long-term health consequences of hearing loss, focusing on its relationship with social isolation, cognitive decline, and incident dementia.
        - It cites meta-analyses and longitudinal studies showing an increased risk—including up to a 24% higher risk—of cognitive impairment associated with unmitigated hearing impairment.
        - It reviews clinical evidence and randomized controlled trials (such as the ACHIEVE and CHOICE trials) assessing whether using hearing aids or cochlear implants can delay or prevent cognitive decline in older adults.
